defect.description: Isinstance(self.log_output, TextIO) never matches a real file: typing.TextIO is not a base class of what open() returns (io.TextIOWrapper, or the io.BufferedWriter of the default os.devnull log), so stop() still leaves every file log open, as before; it should test io.IOBase (or for a close method).

review_items: Default devnull log_output opened as binary is never closed because stop() only checks isinstance TextIO
stop() no longer wraps close in try/except, so an exception can skip process termination and orphan the child
votes.evidence_quote: `stop()` only checks `isinstance(self.log_output, TextIO)`, so the devnull handle leaks every time a `Service` uses the default.
votes.justification: The review flags the `isinstance(..., TextIO)` check in `stop()` and the leaked default devnull log. It blames the binary mode, though, which implies text-mode files would be closed. It misses that `typing.TextIO` matches no real file object, so every file log, including path-opened text logs, stays open.
